summary: Changes required. evals/scripts/production_flywheel.py ingest never ensures the iron-forest-production dataset exists before create_dataset_item. Langfuse 4.14.4 create_dataset_item calls api.dataset_items.create directly and does not auto-create the dataset (verified from the SDK source), while the sibling evals/scripts/langfuse_export.py defines ensure_dataset and calls it before item creation. On a fresh Langfuse project the documented ingest command raises inside create_dataset_item, main() catches it, writes a retryable outbox entry, and exits 0 without creating any draft items; docs/production-flywheel.md does not state this prerequisite. Required: ensure PRODUCTION_DATASET exists before create_dataset_item (mirroring langfuse_export.py) or document the manual dataset creation. All four configured Checks pass (build/vet/test/secrets exit 0), the new Python unit tests pass, and the revision fast-forwards origin/master; blocking only on this intake defect.
